mapper.sql: rt.id, rt.task_name, rt.task_description, rt.business_type, rt.confidentiality_level, rt.priority, rt.status, rt.review_template_id, rt.project_id, rt.creator_id, rt.deadline, rt.auto_assignment_enabled, rt.convergence_gate_enabled, rt.convergence_deadline, rt.review_conclusion, rt.conclusion_reason, rt.progress_data, rt.created_at, rt.updated_at, rt.created_by, rt.updated_by
, u.username as creator_name, u.real_name as creator_real_name, u.email as creator_email, p.project_name, rw.workflow_name

where.if: AND (rt.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rt.task_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND rt.deadline < NOW() AND rt.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'ARCHIVED')

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM review_tasks rt LEFT JOIN users u ON rt.creator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON rt.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN review_workflows rw ON rt.review_template_id = rw.id
ORDER BY CASE rt.priority WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 4 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, rt.created_at DESC

SELECT
FROM review_tasks rt LEFT JOIN users u ON rt.creator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON rt.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN review_workflows rw ON rt.review_template_id = rw.id WHERE rt.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM review_tasks rt WHERE rt.status = 'EXPERT_ASSIGNMENT' AND rt.auto_assignment_enabled = true AND rt.created_at >= #{since} ORDER BY CASE rt.priority WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 4 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, rt.created_at ASC
SELECT FROM review_tasks rt WHERE rt.deadline < NOW() AND rt.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'ARCHIVED') ORDER BY rt.deadline ASC
SELECT FROM review_tasks rt WHERE rt.deadline BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) AND rt.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'ARCHIVED') ORDER BY rt.deadline ASC
